subject: Culture
title: School Uniforms Debate
description: A quick, practical guide to School Uniforms Debate.

hook.text: Japan's school uniforms cost up to $700 per set. Some families can't afford them and kids skip school.

buildup.text: Proponents say uniforms reduce bullying and visible inequality. Critics say they suppress self-expression.

discovery.text: A 2020 meta-study found uniforms have no measurable effect on academic performance or bullying rates.

twist.text: In the UK, secondhand uniform shops near schools reveal the hidden tax that 'equality' imposes on poor families.

climax.text: Students in uniform schools still find ways to signal status: shoes, bags, and haircuts become the new markers.

punchline.text: You can standardize the outfit but not the hierarchy.

quiz.question: What did a 2020 meta-study find about school uniforms?
options: They have no measurable academic effect
